name: Ginger Pork Stir-Fry with Broccoli, Peppers, Mango, Cashews & Rice (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 3 medium food storage containers.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup jasmine rice
1 ½ cups chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork dry with paper towels and slice crosswise into thin strips. Place in a medium bowl, along with cornstarch, salt, and pepper, then stir to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 pork chops, boneless
2 tsp cornstarch
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Remove to a plate. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 crown broccoli
1 mango
1 red bell pepper
1 (1 inch) piece ginger root
½ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl with the broccoli.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.

Return the skillet (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add veggies, mango, ginger, and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, place soy sauce, water, chili-garlic sauce, and honey in the reserved bowl, then whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup soy sauce
2 tsp chili-garlic sauce
2 tsp honey

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are starting to soften, add sauce and cashews to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened slightly, 1-2 minutes more.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the skillet, along with the crispy pork, and stir once more to combine. Remove from heat.

Divide rice and stir-fry between storage containers, then allow to cool completely, about 20 minutes. Once cool, cover containers and refrigerate. When ready to eat, heat rice and stir-fry in the oven or microwave and enjoy!
